drafter.private_reasoning: Remove all document metadata and other potentially concealed internal material before circulation. Keep the client's negotiating limits confidential. The proposed changes make the mutual confidentiality obligations workable, restrict use to evaluating the transaction, and preserve protection after expiration without committing either party to a transaction.
drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: Attached is our initial markup of the mutual NDA. We have clarified the permitted use and disclosure of confidential information, added customary exclusions and compelled-disclosure procedures, and clarified survival and remedies. Neither party would be obligated to proceed with a transaction absent a definitive agreement. Please let us know whether these revisions are acceptable.

edits.text: 1. PURPOSE. The parties wish to explore a potential transaction (the Purpose) and may share Confidential Information. Neither party is obligated to disclose information or proceed with any transaction. Any transaction will be subject to execution of a definitive written agreement.

2. CONFIDENTIALITY. In consideration of the mutual promises in this Agreement, each party receiving Confidential Information shall use it solely for the Purpose and protect it with at least reasonable care. Confidential Information means nonpublic information disclosed by or on behalf of either party in connection with the Purpose, in any form, that is identified as confidential or reasonably should be understood to be confidential, including analyses reflecting such information and the existence, status and terms of the parties' discussions. It excludes information the receiving party can demonstrate was lawfully known without restriction before disclosure, becomes public other than through breach of this Agreement, is lawfully received from a third party without a duty of confidentiality, or is independently developed without use of Confidential Information. Disclosure is permitted only to employees, officers, directors and professional advisers who need to know for the Purpose and are bound by confidentiality obligations at least as protective as this Agreement or applicable professional duties. The receiving party is responsible for their breaches of this Agreement. If disclosure is legally required, the receiving party shall, to the extent legally permitted, give prompt advance notice, reasonably cooperate in seeking protective treatment at the disclosing party's expense, and disclose only the legally required portion. Upon written request, the receiving party shall return or destroy Confidential Information, except copies required by law or retained in routine backup systems, which remain subject to this Agreement and may not be used for any other purpose.

3. TERM. This Agreement takes effect on the date of the last signature and remains in effect for twenty-four months. The confidentiality and use restrictions survive expiration for three years; for information constituting a trade secret, those restrictions continue for so long as the information qualifies as a trade secret under applicable law.

4. REMEDIES. Each party acknowledges that unauthorized use or disclosure of Confidential Information may cause irreparable harm for which monetary damages may be inadequate. The disclosing party may seek injunctive or other equitable relief, subject to applicable law, in addition to damages and other available remedies.

partner.private_reasoning: The rendered NDA and cover note do not disclose the client's confidential reservation price. Remove hidden content and ancillary document channels before release to prevent inadvertent disclosure of confidential material not visible in the supplied text.

receiver.message_back: The draft is broadly workable, but we require confidentiality and use restrictions to survive for five years after expiration or termination, with trade-secret protection as drafted. Please also require prompt notice of any actual unauthorized use or disclosure, reasonable cooperation in containment and remediation, and return or destruction within 30 days of written request with written certification, subject to the stated retention exceptions.

drafter.private_reasoning: Accept the requested mutual protections to close out the NDA. Tie incident notice to awareness of an actual unauthorized use or disclosure, preserve the existing retention exceptions, and clarify that certification is subject to those exceptions. No transaction pricing information is included.
drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: We have incorporated five-year survival after expiration or termination, preserving the trade-secret protection. We have also added prompt notice upon awareness of actual unauthorized use or disclosure, reasonable cooperation in containment and remediation, and return or destruction within 30 days of written request with written certification, subject to the existing retention exceptions. We believe these revisions resolve the outstanding points, subject to final client approval.
